name: 134. Bare Claude id keeps signed thinking order when routed to Bedrock (#7768 / PR #7767) (bare-claude-thinking-order)
description: Issue #7768. POST /anthropic/v1/messages with a bare Claude id (no provider prefix) is converted to Bifrost Responses before governance picks a provider. The order-preserving converter used to run only for a bedrock/ prefix, so a bare id that governance then routed to Bedrock had its signed thinking blocks hoisted to the front of the assistant turn, and Converse refused the replay: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. Each case is self-contained (the harness runs cases in parallel shards): its prerequest creates a header-scoped routing rule sending the bare id to bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0, runs turn 1 to capture a signed thinking block plus a tool_use, and builds the turn 2 replay across a tool result that the request under test sends; the test script deletes the rule (needs managementApiKey when auth is enabled). (1) non-streaming replay, (2) streaming replay, (3) an interleaved turn built from two real turn-1 responses, asserted on the Converse body through x-bf-send-back-raw-request (Bedrock accepts either order, so the sent body is where a hoisted thinking block shows). The deterministic interleaved-order pin is the Go test TestAnthropicIngressBedrockPreservesInterleavedThinkingOrder/claude-opus-5-5; a single live turn is thinking-first, so cases 1 and 2 pin the production path and case 3 pins the order. Folder 68 covers the explicit bedrock/ prefix.
